```
Priority 1: Drawdown control - worst_mdd threshold appears to be gating

Priority 3: Continue macro_alpha_shadow direction - lockbox_min improvement is promising
```

1. Run AUB autopilot with best-selection
2. Execute system-level candidates  
3. Generate next-fix recommendations

Proceed with next commands? Or need specific analysis on any metric?
